Condition: the application note bounds the isolation to 'As long as the signal voltage on the data lines is between the ground- and the VBUS-level'; above it a PN diode to pin 5 conducts. With VBUS present a D+ or D- at up to 3.63 V stays below pin 5 and nothing conducts. With the shared VBUS/charger net unpowered, a line held at 3.3 V forward-biases into pin 5. USB 2.0 section 7.1.5.1 requires the device pull-up not to supply current on the data line when VBUS is removed, so a compliant port leaves D+ undriven then; IOBoard.md does not state VBUS sensing for the port, so this condition is a design item for the owner, not a failing figure
